lines.speaker: Jangala Approach
lines.text: Cerberus-class on the inbound lane, this is Jangala Approach. Your transponder reads a mining escort, decommissioned. Identify yourself and state your business in Corvus.
lines.synthesisText: [flat, procedural, routine radio voice] Cerberus-class on the inbound lane, this is Jangala Approach. Your transponder reads a mining escort, decommissioned. Identify yourself, and state your business in Corvus.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: Jangala Approach, this is Second Wind. Civilian. Crew and families aboard, nothing for sale. We have a surface berth waiting at Venn's yard.
lines.synthesisText: [steady, careful voice] Jangala Approach, this is Second Wind. Civilian. Crew and families aboard, nothing for sale. We have a surface berth waiting at Venn's yard.

lines.speaker: Jangala Approach
lines.text: Second Wind isn't on any register I have.
lines.synthesisText: [dry, unimpressed voice] Second Wind isn't on any register I have.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: No. It's newer than the paint.
lines.synthesisText: [dry, understated voice] No... It's newer than the paint.

lines.speaker: Jangala Approach
lines.text: You're showing point-defence mounts. Are they live?
lines.synthesisText: [sharper, alert voice] You're showing point-defence mounts. Are they live?

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: They're bolted on, Approach. Nothing aboard is live but the crew.
lines.synthesisText: [calm, plain voice] They're bolted on, Approach. Nothing aboard is live but the crew.

lines.speaker: Jangala Approach
lines.text: Second Wind, you're cleared to descend on civilian corridor four. Keep those mounts cold and don't leave the corridor. Patrol has your signature.
lines.synthesisText: [procedural, final radio voice] Second Wind, you're cleared to descend on civilian corridor four. Keep those mounts cold, and don't leave the corridor. Patrol has your signature.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.text: Corridor four, mounts cold. Thank you, Approach.
lines.synthesisText: [relieved, quiet voice] Corridor four, mounts cold. Thank you, Approach.

lines.speaker: Castle
lines.synthesisText: [quiet, half to herself, softly amused] Well. Somebody knows we're here.
